aetheria.config.title: Aetheria Settings
aetheria.config.lodRenderDistance.toolti: How far distant terrain is drawn, in chunks. This is the headline setting; everything else trades quality against the cost of reaching it.
aetheria.config.fullDetailRadius.tooltip: Distance in chunks that is drawn at the finest detail level. Detail halves with every doubling of distance beyond it.
aetheria.config.finestDetailShift.toolti: The finest level of detail Aetheria will use. Lower values are sharper and cost more memory.
aetheria.config.dynamicDetailEnabled.too: Reduce detail while flying high or moving fast, then restore it once you slow down. Keeps frame times smooth during elytra flight.
aetheria.config.colorTolerance.tooltip: How different two surfaces may look and still be merged into one quad. Higher values mean fewer quads and slightly flatter colour.
aetheria.config.meshThreads.tooltip: Threads building LOD geometry. Zero sizes the pool from your processor, leaving headroom for the game itself.
aetheria.config.memoryBudgetMegabytes.to: Soft ceiling on the memory used by loaded LOD data. Terrain past this limit is dropped from memory and reloaded from disk when you return.
Caps how many areas of distant terrain are queued for rebuilding each frame, so streaming terrain never floods the worker queue.
aetheria.config.cacheEnabled.tooltip: Store the terrain you have seen on disk, so it stays visible on servers that have long since stopped sending it.
